title: How Checks-Effects-Interactions Pattern Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Function entry"] --> B
    subgraph checks["1. Checks"]
        B["Validate caller and inputs"] --> C["Verify balance preconditions"]
    end
    subgraph effects["2. Effects"]
        D["Update internal state"] --> E["Deduct balance first"]
    end
    subgraph interactions["3. Interactions"]
        F["External call last"] --> G["Transfer tokens or ETH"]
    end
    C --> D
    E --> F
    G --> H["Reentry sees fresh state"]
    H --> I["Preconditions now fail"]

title: Reentrancy Variants Bypassing Naive Guards
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Attacker calls withdraw"] --> B["Checks pass"]
    B --> C["External call before update"]
    C --> D{"Hook hands control back"}
    subgraph variants["Four exploit paths"]
        E["V1 read stale view oracle"]
        F["V2 re-enter sibling function"]
        G["V3 re-enter other contract"]
        H["V4 token NFT callback hook"]
    end
    D --> E
    D --> F
    D --> G
    D --> H
    E --> I["Inflated virtual price used"]
    F --> J["Shared state, unshared lock"]
    G --> K["Independent guard storage"]
    H --> L["safeTransfer looks inert"]
    I --> M["Funds drained, $80M+ lost"]
    J --> M
    K --> M
    L --> M

title: Layered Reentrancy Defense
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Function entry"] --> B["Set nonReentrant lock"]
    subgraph cei["Enforce CEI ordering"]
        C["Checks"] --> D["Effects update state"]
        D --> E["Interactions call last"]
    end
    B --> C
    E --> F["Release lock"]
    B -.shared.-> G["Same lock across contracts"]
    H["View functions"] --> I["nonReadReentrant guard"]
    I --> J{"Lock active?"}
    J -->|yes| K["Revert stale read"]
    J -->|no| L["Return fresh state"]
